task_completion.description: Create an SVG file named 'star.svg' with a yellow star and black stroke.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A file manager, terminal, or text editor showing 'star.svg' containing SVG code with fill="#FFFF00" (or yellow) and stroke="black".

task_completion.description: Create a new style named 'star_marker' in the GeoServer Styles interface.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The GeoServer 'New Style' page with the name field set to 'star_marker'.

task_completion.description: Configure the SLD to use 'star.svg' as an ExternalGraphic.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The SLD editor showing an <ExternalGraphic> tag with an <OnlineResource> pointing to 'star.svg' and a <Format> of 'image/svg+xml'.

task_completion.description: Set the point symbolization size between 16px and 24px.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The SLD editor showing a <Size> element with a value between 16 and 24.

task_completion.description: Assign 'star_marker' as the default style for the 'ne_populated_places' layer.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Publishing' tab of the 'ne_populated_places' layer settings showing 'star_marker' selected as the Default Style.

task_completion.description: Verify the layer preview shows yellow star icons.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The GeoServer Layer Preview (OpenLayers) for 'ne_populated_places' displaying yellow stars at the location of populated places.

integrity.description: The agent used the GeoServer web interface for configuration rather than just background API calls.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the agent navigating through the GeoServer web UI (Styles, Layers, and Layer Preview pages).

integrity.description: The agent actually defined the SVG content rather than using a placeholder.
integrity.visual_evidence: The SVG code or the resulting visual icon in the preview matches the 'yellow star' description.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply navigate to a pre-existing 'star_marker' style.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the 'Add new style' process and the typing of the style name.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The SVG must be named 'star.svg' and contain fill='#FFFF00' (yellow) and a black stroke. The GeoServer style must be named 'star_marker'. The target layer is 'ne_populated_places'. The size in the SLD must be a numeric value between 16 and 24. The ExternalGraphic format should be 'image/svg+xml'.
